claims.text: Sxtomatic chronic HFrEF: SGLT2i recommended to ↓HF hsp and CV mortality, w or w/o T2DM.
claims.quote: In patients with symptomatic chronic HFrEF, SGLT2i are recommended to reduce hospitalization for HF and cardiovascular mortality, irrespective of the presence of type 2 diabetes.

claims.text: HFmrEF: SGLT2i can be beneficial (↓HF hsp and CV mortality).
claims.quote: In patients with HFmrEF, SGLT2i can be beneficial in decreasing HF hospitalizations and cardiovascular mortality

claims.text: HFpEF: SGLT2i can be beneficial (↓HF hsp and CV mortality).
claims.quote: In patients with HFpEF, SGLT2i can be beneficial in decreasing HF hospitalizations and cardiovascular mortality.
